title: Bechtel and Monsanto possibly handling alien bodies and biological specimens

tellings.quote: I was also told that Monsanto may have historically been involved, most likely dealing with biological specimens.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a claim that Bechtel, a large engineering company, and Monsanto, a chemical and farming company, may have handled alien bodies and biological samples in secure underground sites. Michels says he was told Monsanto may have been involved in the past, most likely dealing with the biological samples. If true, it would mean private companies have been caring for nonhuman remains in secret.
